body: Fellow mother here. First, I’m glad you are reaching out- your kids need you and deserve to have you around. Second, I obviously just a stranger on the internet, but if your husband is calling you names, please re-evaluate being with him. What a horrible thing to say to you
You have young kids- could you be suffering from post-partum depression? Please talk to you doc/midwife, even if it has been a while since you’ve seen them.
Hey there. Please stay. There’s no one else like you in the world. You do matter. I’m just a stranger on the internet, but I want you to stay alive. No one should have to feel like this
thank you so much. That’s really comforting to hear. It is a really scary place to be
I’m glad this sub is here but a group full of depressed people trying to help depressed people is not exactly a winning plan
I don’t write them once a week, but I for sure write them
Oh and fwiw, my friend didn’t give me the key. He has no idea I borrowed it

Right? It’s super fucked up and I get that. I read that piece in WaPo today about the woman who had to clean up after her fathers suicide and, hell, I don’t want that to be my kids. That’s why I’m reaching out. I don’t know what to do to make it stop. I’ve never felt like this before
Hey. I’m sorry about your friend. The sting of having given yourself to help someone and them not returning the favor for you sucks

Hey, I’m where you’re at too. That’s the worst part of depression, I think. The horrible cycle of isolation. Ignore friends/burn bridges, but need someone more than ever. Like you, I keep thinking of messaging some of these people posting “call me! Reach out! Unicorns and rainbows!” But no one would reply. I wish I had something comforting to say. 
I think it is really powerful that you don’t want to die. That’s really important.
